text:
Type: gooseneck LED desk lamp
Use: focused reading and task light at a desk or bedside; home office, study, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: copper-colored metal flexible gooseneck arm, small metal LED head, round metal base, black cord
Colors: shiny rose copper, black cord
Shape: slim flexible arm that rises and arcs over into a tiny teardrop head, small round weighted base, very thin and light, compact
Feel: sleek, warm, delicate, modern
Goes with: white desks, light or dark wood, blush and grey tones, brass or copper accents; contemporary or glam home offices

product.name: JANSJ
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
